provenance_note: From a retail-bank brand sign-standards family. All client/vendor/human/address data excluded; banking vertical retained; copy structure only.

knowledge.plain_language_summary: An internally illuminated double-sided pole sign: routed aluminum face cabinets on a clad steel pole, with pocket-routed clear-acrylic push-through letters and an illuminated logo element. Offered in four heights.
knowledge.rationale: An engineered steel head-and-base column on a concrete foundation carries the cabinet loads at height, making this a composite structure rather than a simple cabinet.

structure.construction: steel pipe head-support column + steel square-tube base support column, in concrete foundation with anchor bolts/base plate
.125in routed aluminum cladding painted brand silver, 4x2x.125in aluminum tube frames, .063in/.125in aluminum faces, 3/4in clear acrylic pocket-routed push-through letters, UL raceway, SloanLED 6500K

materials_manifest.product: 3M translucent films (3635-70 white, 3630-125 yellow-gold, 3632-157 Sultan Blue)

craft_observations: Engineered steel column + foundation + aluminum cladding = composite structure.
Pocket-routed acrylic push-through letters are a clean lit detail at height.

modeling_notes: SloanLED illumination captured in structure construction per consumable policy (not a materials_manifest row).
